name: Tabata Akihisa
source:
Shuichi's immediate subordinate, A.

He joined the company at the same time as Nanami and works directly under Shuichi.

He is hardworking and takes his job seriously, approaching everything with a sincere and earnest attitude.

He has a straightforward, uncompromising personality. Once he has made up his mind about something, he can be stubborn enough to refuse to back down even when his superior, Shuichi, disagrees with him.

Back when Nanami was still working at the company, he secretly harbored romantic feelings for her.

When he reunited with Nanami after being invited to dinner at her home, those old feelings reignited.

Since then, he has remained devoted to her, continuing to harbor unwavering romantic feelings.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
